title: Recognized Student Organizations (Campus Activities)
text:
Recognized Student Organizations (RSOs)

What RSOs are: 'student-led groups created by and for students around shared interests, identities, or goals.' They support student community, leadership, and engagement. USC has more than 800 student organizations, which run many campus programs and events.

Finding and joining RSOs: The page does not describe how to join a specific group. It links to a search tool, 'Search for Student Organizations,' which points to EngageSC.

Official directory platform: EngageSC, https://engage.usc.edu/

Involvement fairs: The page lists no dates for the spring fair. It says 'Information on the Spring Involvement Fair will be shared soon.' It thanks RSOs that tabled at the Fall Involvement Fair.

Event planning and space: The page does not include steps for event planning or space reservations. It says questions about events and fundraisers can be directed to Campus Activities office hours.

RSO recognition (annual): Spring 2027 recognition is open on EngageSC for new RSOs and those re-establishing after a lapse. Recognition for 2026-2027 runs from August 1 to June 30, regardless of approval date. Organizations that do not renew on time lose recognition and all benefits for the year.

Office hours (drop-in, for RSO questions): Tuesdays, 11:00 am-12:00 pm, on Zoom or in person at SKS 410 (check in at front desk). Fridays, 2:00 pm-3:00 pm, on Zoom or in person at SKS 410 (check in at front desk).

Contact: Steven & Kathryn Sample Hall (SKS) 410, 3607 Trousdale Parkway, Los Angeles, CA 90089. Phone: 213-740-5649. Email: campact@usc.edu (the page's mailto link points to stuacts@usc.edu; verify). Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am-5:00 pm.
